notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 18.
Your devotion to black is at least ten or you have at least two opponents.
description:
Cast Buried Alive by paying {2} and two life, searching for Chainer, Viscera Seer, and Kokusho.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1} and two life.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Chainer onto the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kokusho.
Kokusho dies, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Resolve the Viscera Seer, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 5.
